summary: Conversation turn index for long chats, plus routing diagnostics and transcript layout fixes.

changes.title: Conversation turn index
changes.summary: Jump between user prompts in long conversations with a compact turn rail beside the transcript.
user_impact: Click turn ticks beside the transcript to jump to any user prompt
Use Ctrl+↑ and Ctrl+↓ to move between turns
Hover a tick for turn number and prompt preview with smooth scroll

changes.title: Routing debug logging
changes.summary: Routing debug logging is enabled by default to simplify RAG and memory routing diagnosis.
user_impact: Easier diagnosis of retrieval and memory routing issues from standard logs
developer_notes: Hardened RAG and memory capability routing

changes.title: Prompts UI hang
changes.summary: Fixed a hang when opening or using the prompts UI.
user_impact: Prompts UI opens and responds without freezing

changes.title: Turn index layout
changes.summary: Transcript turn-index layout preserves column width and responsive layout modes.
user_impact: Turn rail stays aligned at 800px and 1200px layout breakpoints
